description:
In crate-jmap-chat-server MemoryBackend query_objects for Message, the hasMention filter (spec §4.13) currently only checks the mentions array for the owner's ChatContact.id. It must also match messages where a broadcastMention's resolved recipient set includes the owner.

For the MemoryBackend reference impl, the resolution is:
- scope='everyone': always matches (owner is always a member)
- scope='here': matches if owner's PresenceStatus.availability is not 'unavailable' (deployment-defined predicate; reference impl uses this simple check)
- scope='admins': matches if owner holds any role with admin-level permissions in the Space (deployment-defined predicate; reference impl can check for manage_space or a similar high-permission)

The hasMention filter validation at message.rs:207-211 already parses the boolean. The MemoryBackend needs the actual filtering logic.

Note: the handler already validates that Message/query requires either chatId or hasMention:true (message.rs:212-214). This bead only adds the broadcast-mention resolution to the existing hasMention filter path.
title: Extend hasMention filter to resolve broadcast mentions
